objective: TIME-POLISH PPO on jungle6: start from the bc49 panorama BC student and optimize EXPECTED COMPLETION TIME with the recipe that achieved tier_1 on Jungle1 (lineage.recipe_validation: student median 3058 beat teacher 3134 at 16/16, concluded by the preregistered stagnation clause). HONEST EVIDENCE DELTA versus both prior premises: the Jungle1 init carried a 10,000-seed tail receipt (98.56% win rate) and the Jungle4 init carried 8/8 panorama wins; THIS init won 4/8 on the panorama gate (hold 8, max_ticks 30000) and 12/16 = 0.7500 on the exact 16-seed checkpoint panel measured at hold 4 BEFORE this freeze (median winning ticks 11991.0; lineage.init_baseline_panel16 - note the panel rate is HIGHER than the small-sample panorama rate, exactly the kind of level-panel calibration the jungle8 lesson said to measure rather than assume). A quarter of the panel is unwon at init, so the win-search gradient is live alongside the polish gradient, and the relative floor of clause (a) (max(0.50, 0.7500 - 0.05) = 0.70) is calibrated so that the run is stopped only for degrading BELOW its own receipted starting point, not for failing to meet a bar the init never held (the exact failure mode of the jungle8 stop, lineage.floor_lesson). The premise stands on the validated Jungle1 mechanism: when the +10 win bonus appears in most episodes, the return's residual variance is dominated by the 5x time term (-0.0005/native tick) and PPO polishes speed instead of searching for wins; the truncation-neutral wrapper plus the win-dominance ordering (worst win +4.0 > best failure -9.0) keep both gradients pointed the right way. Success is measured in median winning ticks at a win-rate floor; SCORE IS NOT A SUCCESS METRIC.

The predict is deterministic masked argmax; cross-device float differences can in principle flip near-ties, and any systematic win-rate shift traceable to device alone would be reportable, not paper-overable. reward_resolution.how_the_validator_resolves_it: carried verbatim from the pattern document (the resolution path is unchanged): v2._configs_v2 hands environment.reward_profile to v2._reward_config_v2; each of profile_id, win_reward, failure_reward, time_penalty_per_native_tick present in the mapping OVERRIDES the v2 defaults; score_progress_reward_cap is owned by TrainerV2Config (trainer_v2.score_progress_reward_cap, here 1.0). profile_id is a label checked only for non-emptiness; the id win-time5x-score-truncation-neutral-v3 is REUSED because the profile it names is bitwise the same profile.
reward_resolution.ordering_guarantees: the composed training wrapper is DenseShapingObservableHumanSpeedrunWrapper; its _validate_reward_ordering enforces minimum win return > maximum terminated-failure return: (10 + (-0.0005 x 12000)) = +4.0 > (-10 + 1.0) = -9.0, satisfied with margin 13.0 at jungle6's max_ticks 12000 (identical arithmetic to the pattern: jungle levels are not in the long-horizon prefix list). The base-wrapper one-second dominance rule is deliberately dropped by the v2 dense-shaping mixin, exactly as documented in the pattern.
reward_resolution.magnitude_rationale: 5x clock signal, unchanged from the validated recipe. At the measured panel median (11991 ticks, hold 4, max_ticks 30000) the time term costs ~-6.0 against +10; at the training horizon the worst POSSIBLE win costs -6.0, still netting +4.0, so winning strictly dominates everything and the residual gradient on winning episodes is the clock. A 500-tick speedup is worth +0.25 per episode, the same well-posed polish signal that took Jungle1 from median 3833 to 3058.

clause_a_win_rate_floor.clause: if the 16-seed eval win rate is below 0.70 (i.e. 11/16 or fewer wins, since 11/16 = 0.6875 < 0.70) at TWO CONSECUTIVE checkpoints, STOP the run and keep the best earlier checkpoint. The floor is max(0.50, 0.7500 - 0.05) = 0.70: RELATIVE to the measured init baseline of 12/16 = 0.7500 (lineage.init_baseline_panel16).
clause_a_win_rate_floor.best_checkpoint_rule: best = highest 16-seed win rate; ties broken by lower median winning ticks; the BC init itself is the fallback if no checkpoint qualifies - and unlike the pattern document's fallback, this init HAS a receipt on this exact panel (12/16, median 11991.0), so the fallback comparison is like-for-like by construction
clause_a_win_rate_floor.rationale: the jungle8 stop (lineage.floor_lesson) showed a fixed floor punishes the run for the init's own miss rate; this floor stops the run only for falling BELOW its receipted starting point minus the 5pp allowance. In panel terms: 12/16 matches init, and one lost seed (11/16) at two consecutive checkpoints triggers the stop.

clause_b_stagnation_success.clause: if the median winning ticks of the 16-seed eval fails to improve on the best median observed so far at THREE CONSECUTIVE checkpoint evals, CONCLUDE THE RUN SUCCESSFULLY with the best checkpoint
clause_b_stagnation_success.best_checkpoint_rule: best = lowest median winning ticks among checkpoints whose 16-seed win rate is >= the clause (a) floor (0.70)
clause_b_stagnation_success.rationale: time-polish saturates; three flat checkpoints (~786k steps) is the preregistered definition of converged. This clause is not a hypothesis: it fired on Jungle1 exactly as designed and banked the champion. UNCHANGED from the pattern document except that its best rule references the relative floor.

trainer_v2.reward_alignment: cap 1.0 and the 5x time term carried unchanged from the validated recipe. Arithmetic at jungle6's max_ticks 12000: worst win = 10 - 6.0 = +4.0; best truncation (truncation-neutral) = about -6.0 + 1.0 = -5.0; best terminated failure = -10 + 1.0 - time < -9.0. Ordering: every win > every truncation > every terminated failure; on winning episodes the clock is the dominant residual signal, which is the entire point of this run.
trainer_v2.discounting_note: gamma applies PER MACRO STEP; the macro reward is the undiscounted per-tick sum over the ticks the macro consumed, so 0.999 per macro is roughly 0.999^(1/40) per native tick; truncation is reward-neutral (v2 wrapper), so a timed-out episode bootstraps instead of paying -10
